meta_title: Constance Weber | IT change management, PMO & transformation
meta_desc: IT change management, PMO and transformation, based in Paris. ESSEC graduate, French, English and Japanese. Looking to join a consulting firm or an in-house transformation team.
hero_role: IT change management, PMO & transformation, Paris
hero_lead: I'm Constance. I work on IT change management, transformation and CSR: when new tools, systems or ways of working arrive, I build the tools, run the trainings and workshops, and follow the numbers until teams have really adopted them.
st_sagae_sub: A year in a Japanese high school
work_lead: Side projects to put my methods into the hands of teams that can't always afford a consultant. No account, no server, no data collected.
p1_for: For IT and supply chain companies
p1_desc: 20 questions on environment, labour, ethics and procurement. The tool gives a score per theme, the regulations that apply to your regions and a prioritised action plan, with an 85 item checklist and a short PDF report.
p1_shows: What it shows: how I turn CSR frameworks (EcoVadis, ISO 27001, CSRD) into concrete next steps.
p2_desc: A 15 statement survey based on the ADKAR model. The dashboard shows where each team gets stuck, its level of resistance and the actions to take, with response tracking, an action plan and a presentation mode for steering committees.
p2_shows: What it shows: how I measure adoption and make the results usable in a steering committee.
e1_ctx: IBM wanted to deliver even better for Hermès (support and other services), which meant leading a change with its team of 120 IBM consultants.
e1_did: As PMO, I led this change: I redesigned the time tracking practices with the team and ran workshops to bring the consultants on board. I built AI-powered PMO tools (financial tracking, capacity, contracts), trained the teams to use them, and produced the KPI reports and dashboards. In parallel, I work in an IBM research team on an AI ticketing solution built with watsonx, on the interface and the chat experience.
e1_res: New time tracking practices for 120 consultants, shared PMO tools and KPI dashboards.
e2_did: Built organisation tools and process frameworks for the consulting team, and managed the strategic partner pipeline with CRM workflows.
e3_ctx: A data consulting firm that needed to prove its CSR and security practices to large clients.
e3_did: I ran the EcoVadis, CyberVadis and ISO 27001 processes end to end and wrote the governance documents and charters. As a manager, I rebuilt a team under pressure and led a complete overhaul in 6 months: IT systems, documentation, legal charters.
e3_res: +22% on average on the sustainability and security ratings.
e4_did: Coordinated a software migration across more than 8 countries. I was the day to day link between the technical teams in France, the UK and India, and ran the agile rituals and the delivery schedule.
